title: SoundBridge
lines: SoundBridge，为听障人士设计的环境感知手表。
SoundBridge is an environmental awareness watch for deaf and hard-of-hearing people.

title: 身后的车铃
lines: 小林沿着步道去上班。她看得见前方，却可能错过身后骑行者的车铃。
Xiaolin can see the path ahead. A bicycle bell behind her is easier to miss.

title: 她决定怎样让行
en: A cue she can act on
lines: 手腕轻振三下。她抬腕看到左后方的标记，转头确认，再往旁边让出一点空间。
Three taps get her attention. She checks the rear-left marker, looks back and makes room.

title: 四个收音孔
lines: 同一声车铃，先后抵达表壳上的四个麦克风。处理器比较这段微小的时差，估算声音的来向。
The bell reaches four microphones at slightly different times. Their relative delays reveal its bearing.

title: 哪些声音值得提醒？
lines: 手表上的 AI 比较声谱，区分车铃、鸣笛、警笛和施工声。风声和人群底噪留在背景里。
On-device AI compares sound patterns. Bells, horns, sirens and roadworks can prompt a cue while background noise stays quiet.

title: 抬腕后，方向也更新
en: A bearing relative to the dial
lines: 手腕转动时，表盘的十二点方向也在变。小林自然抬腕，姿态稳定后，箭头才显示新的相对角度。
As her wrist turns, twelve o’clock turns with it. The pointer updates once her wrist settles.

title: 路口的两次长振
lines: 路口传来鸣笛，手腕长振两下。小林手臂仍垂着。声音持续、提醒尚未确认时，手表隔一会儿再振，逐步增强。
Two long pulses mark a horn. While the event persists without acknowledgement, reminders repeat at intervals and grow stronger.

title: 等车通过
lines: 小林停在路缘内。她抬腕看清来向，点按结束提醒，抬头观察，等车过去再走。
At the curb, she checks the bearing, taps to end the alert and watches the vehicle pass before moving on.

title: SoundBridge
lines: （无旁白）车辆驶远，小林沿步道继续前行。
No voice-over. The car recedes and Xiaolin continues on her way.
